verdict.rationale: Mistral's API reference documents a List Models endpoint (`GET /v1/models`) and a Retrieve Model endpoint, so an agent can enumerate the live catalog programmatically. The model-lifecycle docs add context on model stages, but they say nothing about whether lifecycle status is exposed in the endpoint response. The OpenAPI spec probe returned 404, which weakens machine-readable discovery. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent confirmation that the endpoint returns the live catalog, documented response fields such as lifecycle or deprecation status, and a reachable machine-readable OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented models endpoint

citations.quote: Programmatic catalog discovery documented in the API reference: "List Models" (`GET /v1/models`) and "Retrieve Model" endpoints.
